column2: Peeking into the classroom after school,<LF>Chiyuru, in her pilot suit, was staring fixedly at a terminal.
I see, I see... so to cover indirect thought control,<LF>they've packed a function in here... hmm hmm...
Chiyuru, what are you up to in a place like this?
Ah, %usernameusernameuserna%! Yoo-hoo♪
You had a serious look on your face. Is something troubling you?
Ah, you were watching? It's nothing troubling,<LF>I was looking at the vital data from riding the unit in this suit～♪
Oh, that's interesting. Show me.
Ehh～? You perv, %usernameusernameuserna%～♪
Haaah!? Why does it come to that!?
Because it's packed with raw data like my three sizes, you know?<LF>Wanting to see that makes you a perv～♪
...As a training commander, I have to have a full grasp of my students' data.<LF>So, show me.
Eh!? Are you seriously saying that!?
This is legitimate work, you know?<LF>Come on, hurry up and show me.
Ahh, no... even if you say that... mmm,<LF>having a maiden's secret like this looked at is...
But if it's you, %usernameusernameuserna%, then maybe... no, still no!<LF>These are numbers I let my guard down on, I can't show them...!
...Sorry, it was a joke.<LF>I didn't think you'd actually panic over it.
...Hey, %usernameusernameuserna%～!<LF>Teasing me like that is just mean!
Ow ow! Sorry! That was my fault...!
With her cheeks still puffed out, Chiyuru<LF>whacked me, unresisting, for a while.
It's not some lewd intent.<LF>There's data that'll be useful going forward, right?
If you put it that way, in the process of optimizing for my piloting,<LF>a whole range of analysis data comes out～
Want to look at it together, if you like?<LF>I wanted to hear your opinion too, %usernameusernameuserna%.
You don't mind?
Yeah, yeah.<LF>But don't go hunting for naughty data the moment I look away, okay?
...Nfufu, I'm kidding.<LF>Don't look at me with those judging eyes～.
And so Chiyuru and I checked the data together,<LF>trading opinions at length.
